newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Maxtel to get new joint-owner, issue shares.
newsitem.headline: Maxtel to get new joint-owner, issue shares.

text.p: South African telecommunications equipment supplier Maxtel Ltd said on Friday that it had sealed a deal to secure a new joint-owner and would issue new shares to raise funds for new projects.
The firm said Telular South Africa, which currently owns 71 percent of the group, had agreed to sell 2.67 million shares to to Midland-Molefe Property Group Ltd for 2.4 million rand
Midland-Molefe is to change its name to Lehlabile Investment Co Ltd (LIC).
The deal will see LIC hold 33.3 percent of Maxtel and Telular retain 37.7 percent.
"It is the intention of LIC and Telular to procure that Maxtel extends a rights offer to its shareholders in due course to raise capital," Maxtel said.
It added the new cash would be used to fund new ventures in broadcasting, telecommunications, electronics and information systems.
